topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I heard today that the place I used to go to, the one with the windows looking out over the street where the old man feeds the pigeons every afternoon, is shutting down. They said it was a month from now, but it feels like it's tomorrow. I can't help but wonder what will happen to the little drawings on the mirror by the entrance, made by kids over the years. Will anyone remember the waiter with the perfectly lined moustache, who always knew what I would order before I did? Maybe I'll go back one last time, just to say goodbye, even though I know it won’t change anything.
